en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a small rural railway station labeled "HJELLUM" on the station building, with train tracks running toward the foreground. To the right is a wooden house with a balcony and garden shrubs. There are level‑crossing gates, telegraph poles, and trees in the background. The caption in Norwegian at the bottom reads "Parti ved Hjellum St." and a small credit in the lower right mentions the photographer/publisher.
